name: customer_accounts
title: Customers' accounts
description: Who each customer is in the business's own records, for its assistant: their WhatsApp number (digits with the country code, 2348031234567) or Telegram chat id, and their wallet or account at the payments service (an iswallet wallet, or a bank account linked through Mono), and the phone number their invoices are under when it differs. The assistant reads a customer's own account only through this table, never by what they write.
